National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)

The NSF GRFP recognizes and supports outstanding graduate students in NSF-supported STEM disciplines who are pursuing research-based master's and doctoral degrees.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be a citizen, national, or permanent resident of the United States.
  • Must intend to enroll in a full-time degree program in an accredited STEM institution.
  • Early-career graduate students who have never completed more than one academic year of graduate study.
  • Past recipients of the Graduate Research Fellowship are ineligible.

Award Terms

Five-year fellowship period providing three years of financial support: an annual stipend of $37,000 along with a $16,000 cost of education allowance paid directly to the graduate institution.

The submission deadline for Computer and Information Science is 20 October 2026.
